text: Si tawiino Men neeminiraali ma tabintingol ma e hoore goonga kan, gomɗii hari a ɓadike ooñaade e maɓɓe yoga e ooñagol, jaɓanaa ɓe ko ɓe fewjanmaa kon, sabu tiiɗugol hodo maɓɓe e saɗtugol janfaaji maɓɓe wonndude e fantude rerɗugol maa e gomɗinal maɓɓe, kono Men reenumaa e ooñagol faade e maɓɓe.
